focus: Lug quality standard and improve-before-notify workflow
thinking: User named two things: the quality bar for lugs (golden rule — write what you would want to find cold) and the workflow gate (improve skill must run before user is notified). These are complementary: golden rule sets the intent, improve skill enforces it mechanically. Neither is sufficient alone. A terse lug that passes through improve will get caught. The improve skill being a required step in lug creation rather than optional post-processing is a significant workflow change — it means the agent cannot declare a lug done until improve has run.
